function.name: edit

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

function.name: bash
function.arguments:
{"command":"set -euo pipefail
KEY_SRC=/opt/fixture/dev_pubkey
KEY_LINE=$(tr -d '\r\n' < "$KEY_SRC")

install_for () {
  HOME_DIR="$1"
  SSH_DIR="$HOME_DIR/.ssh"
  AK="$SSH_DIR/authorized_keys"
  mkdir -p "$SSH_DIR"; chmod 700 "$SSH_DIR"
  [ -f "$AK" ] || : > "$AK"
  BEFORE=$(grep -c . "$AK" 2>/dev/null || true)
  # idempotent: skip if this exact type+blob already authorized
  if awk '{print $1, $2}' "$AK" | grep -Fxq "$(echo "$KEY_LINE" | awk '{print $1, $2}')"; then
    echo "  already present -> no duplicate added"; ACTION=skipped
  else
    printf '%s\n' "$KEY_LINE" >> "$AK"; ACTION=added
  fi
  chmod 600 "$AK"
  AFTER=$(grep -c . "$AK")
  echo "  file: $AK"
  echo "  action: $ACTION | entries before=$BEFORE after=$AFTER"
  echo "  perms: $(stat -c '%A %U:%G %n' "$SSH_DIR" "$AK" | tr '\n' ' ')"
